opening.argument: The video promises free iTunes gift cards and shows viewers a choice of amounts from $10 to $50 before instructing them to click "Get free code." The description supplies an external link tied to that promised benefit. This is a direct path from a purported free reward to another destination, while the supplied material does not establish how any code would actually be delivered. The concern rests on the visible offer and instruction, not on a claim that viewers lost money or that anyone received a code.
